sentences.text:
Author: U. Durga Prasad Rao
Bench: U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice U. Durga Prasad Rao
 Criminal Petition No.6033 Of 2019
Order:

1. In this Criminal Petition, filed under Section 482 of Cr.P.C., the Petitioner/A1 seeks to quash the proceedings against him in Crime No.215 of 2019 of Lalapet Police Station, Guntur Urban, which was registered against him and others for the offences under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 and 420 IPC and Sections 58, 59, 63 & 64 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short, 'the FSS Act').

2. The allegations against the Petitioner/A1 and other accused, briefly, are that on 29.06.2019 at 03.00 p.m., when the complainant along with his staff including the mediators rushed to Peddapalli Sandhu, Lalapet Area, Guntur town, found the petitioners/A1 to A7 possessing the banned tobacco products, and on interrogation as the accused voluntarily confessed to have been engaged in the business of prohibited tobacco products, seized the same, registered F.I.R., remanded them to judicial custody for the offences stated supra.

3. Learned counsel for petitioner while denying the FIR allegations would submit that even if the prosecution case is accepted to be true, tobacco products would not fall within the definition of Section 3(j) of FSS Act and therefore the police are not authorized to register the crime, investigate and file charge sheet and therefore registration of the FIR is contrary to the provisions of FSS Act.
He relied upon the order of this Court in Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.08.2018.
As can be seen, in the said UDPR,J common order a learned Judge of this Court partly allowed the Criminal Petitions and quashed the offences punishable under Indian Penal Code and FSS Act.

4. So far as the offence under Section 188 of IPC is concerned, as per Section 195(1)(a)(i) of Cr.P.C,
no Court shall take cognizance of the said offence except on the complaint in writing of that Court or by such Officer of the Court as that Court may authorise in writing in this behalf, or of some other Court to which that Court is subordinate.
However, in the instant case, the F.I.R is registered suo moto on the report of the Sub- Inspector of Police, Lalapet Police Station, Guntur Urban.

Therefore,
it is violation of Section 195 of Cr.P.C so far as Section 188 of IPC is concerned, and therefore, the said offence is also liable to be quashed.

5. Following the above order and for the reasons recorded therein, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings initiated against the petitioner/A1 for the offences under Sections 188, 272,

1 273, 328 and 420 IPC and Sections 58, 59, 63 & 64 of the FSS Act are hereby quashed.
